summary: Hindi Mode testing. Backend: the new test_hindi_advice.py passes 8/8. /api/advice language='hi' returns the same keys with Devanagari values and stores them in scans.advice_hi (advice is separate). The second call for the same language takes under 3s (cached). A request with no language field defaults to en. language='fr' returns 422. An anonymous request for an owned scan returns 404. Regression suites: 18/19 pass. The one failure is the known glioma_tumor_1 -> meningioma misclassification from iteration 3. Frontend: the toggle shows 'हिंदी' in English mode and 'English' in Hindi mode. html lang switches to 'hi', and localStorage neurocare_lang persists across reload. The hero, uploader (placeholder 'जैसे मुंबई, 400001', analyze button), nav (testids unchanged), sign-in 'साइन इन', footer, /history signed-out prompt, /about including the model-status labels, and /downloads ('लें' buttons) all render in Hindi. Hindi scan flow with pituitary_tumor_5: verdict 'पिट्यूटरी (संभावित)', class bars and heatmap text in Hindi, all 7 advice cards in Devanagari in about 18s. Toggling to EN re-fetched advice in about 12s. Toggling back to HI took 0.35s (cached). After 3 rapid toggles the final state matched the final language, with no stale advice. Signed-in /history in Hindi shows 'नमस्ते, Priya.', hi-IN date format and the Hindi overview. Logout works.

minor.issue: No in-flight dedupe. Two concurrent uncached requests for the same scan+language both call GPT, and the last write wins. On first load in dev (StrictMode double effect) two 'hi' requests went out. This wastes cost and latency.

ui_bugs.issue: The header nav overflows horizontally (scrollWidth 576-608 vs 390). The language-toggle (x=447) and the sign-in button (x=525) are off-screen in both EN and HI. Mobile users cannot easily reach the one-click Hindi switch. Nav labels also wrap onto 2-3 lines.

integration_issues.issue: While new-language advice loads (about 12-20s), the old-language advice cards stay visible under the loader. Once loading finishes the content is correct. Consider dimming or hiding the old cards during the switch.
A scan analysed only in Hindi (advice_hi only) shows no overview in EN mode, because ScanCard only falls back from hi to en and not from en to hi.

issues: Small uppercase labels with tracking-[0.2em] (e.g. 'चरण 1 / 2', 'डाउनलोड', 'इस परिणाम के बारे में', 'ट्यूमर हीटमैप', 'आपातकालीन संपर्क') get letter-spacing that breaks Devanagari matras and conjuncts into separated glyphs. Use tracking-normal when lang==='hi' (e.g. :lang(hi) .tracking-\[0\.2em\] { letter-spacing: 0 }).
Missing data-testid on the download link

action_items: Make the header responsive on mobile (hamburger menu or a compact nav) so the language-toggle and sign-in stay visible at 390px
Remove the wide letter-spacing on Devanagari text in Hindi mode (:lang(hi) override)
Optional: hide or dim stale advice cards while the other language loads
Optional: in ScanCard fall back to advice_hi when advice is missing in EN mode
Optional: dedupe concurrent /api/advice LLM calls per scan+language
Add data-testid to the download 'Get' link
critical_code_review_comments: Results.jsx: on an advice error after a language switch, the old advice is kept and the error is hidden (adviceError && !advice), so the user sees old-language content with no error message
server.py /api/advice: there is no lock or in-flight cache, so duplicate GPT calls are possible
Downloads.jsx: the <a> download link is missing a data-testid

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all Hindi flows work; mobile header overflow)

seed_data_creation: Test users and sessions were created via mongosh; all users, sessions and scans were cleaned up afterwards
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hindi mode works end to end. Remaining work is mobile header overflow, Devanagari letter-spacing and minor UX items. Run pytest tests/test_hindi_advice.py; it makes real GPT calls and takes about 35s.
